verdict_B_source_quality.basis: The change replaces a one-shot row lookup with the existing bounded waitFor helper (45 seconds, 100 ms polling). Each sample scopes to Saved captures and exact source title, requires exactly one match, scrolls that row into view, and checks elementFromPoint at the intended click point. Trusted CDP mouse input is sent only after the accepted sample. This directly addresses asynchronous list population behind tab activation. Cleanup still requires admin role, a created/partial-owned fixture receipt, approved organization equality, exact configured source IDs when present, distinct provenance flags and landing ID/identity/org proofs. It reopens the detail and verifies the web-app Source URL ID equals the fixture ID before clicking Delete; it then verifies the named row is absent. I found no arbitrary-row selection or new delete path in this commit.

findings.finding: The row can move or be covered between the accepted DOM hit-test sample and CDP input dispatch; the 45-second wait solves late population, not that narrow post-sample race.
findings.impact: A transient layout shift can still produce a timeout or an ineffective click, but the runner does not fall through to a different row because exact-title uniqueness and hit-testing gate dispatch.
findings.action: No source change required for this scoped readiness repair. If a native run shows this failure recurring after readiness, capture a fresh hit-test immediately before dispatch or use the established trusted feature-click helper where applicable.
